title: release: the early canon-spill check discards claude upgrade's failure and reads it as no spill
body:
The release driver's early canon-spill check reads `intent claude upgrade 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^would write: //p'` (`bin/.devbin/cmd/build.d/release:861`). If `claude upgrade` fails, its stderr is discarded and the empty output reads as "no spill", so the check passes. The late check after `claude upgrade --apply` still catches a real spill, but only after VERSION, the lock and the schema faces have been stamped.

Fix: keep the command's exit status and stderr, and abort when it fails. XS. vc's next-line list, item 6.


CLOSED 2026-09-19, by its landing in dc's train B on vc's word (bank 542739194, patch-id 342f1579fa74, judged green on the train's bats log refs/bank/dc/trainB/bats.log: every arm green on the fixed script and the new arm red on the unfixed one).
